headline: Canada and China Agree to Further Reciprocal Tariff Cuts at APEC
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed to implement further mutual tariff reductions following bilateral discussions at the APEC summit.
why: Tariff reductions between major trading nations reduce import costs, support bilateral commodity flows, and ease geopolitical friction.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Lower bilateral trade barriers support export-oriented trade flows between Canada and China.
